import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACC = {"SQT-3":"P08124","DPY-17":"Q20778","DPY-5":"P91285","DPY-2":"P35799","DPY-3":"Q19079",
       "DPY-7":"P34688","DPY-10":"P35800","DPY-13":"P17657","SQT-1":"P12114","SQT-2":"O17209",
       "ROL-6":"P20784","BLI-2":"O01904","BLI-6":"Q8MXR1","COL-19":"P18835","DPY-8":"Q18345",
       "DPY-9":"O16787","COL-12":"P20630","ROL-8":"P18831"}
def seqof(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90).json()["sequence"]["value"]
S={k:seqof(v) for k,v in ACC.items()}
def plddt(a):
    r=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{a}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=90)
    return {int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in r.text.split("\n")
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"} if r.status_code==200 else {}
PL={k:plddt(v) for k,v in ACC.items()}
def gxy1(seq,minrep=4):
    for i in range(len(seq)-3*minrep):
        if all(seq[i+3*t]=="G" for t in range(minrep)): return i+1
    return len(seq)

rows=[]
for k,s in S.items():
    fg=gxy1(s); pl=PL[k]
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))',s):
        p1=m.start()+4
        if p1>=fg: continue
        P1p=s[p1] if p1<len(s) else "-"
        w=[pl[p] for p in range(max(1,p1-5),min(len(s),p1+6)) if p in pl]
        pw=float(np.mean(w)) if w else np.nan
        # transparent composite score, components stated explicitly
        c_motif = 2.0 if s[p1-2] in "KR" else 0.0          # optimal furin R-X-K/R-R
        c_motif+= 1.0 if s[p1-3] in "KR" else 0.0          # P3 basic
        c_prime = 1.0 if P1p in "QASGN" else (-2.0 if P1p=="P" else 0.0)
        c_pos   = 1.5 if (fg-p1)<=40 else 0.0              # at the propeptide/triple-helix junction
        c_dis   = 1.5 if (not np.isnan(pw) and pw<60) else 0.0
        rows.append(dict(collagen=k,acc=ACC[k],motif=m.group(1),P1_pos=p1,P1prime=P1p,
            dist_to_GXY=fg-p1, plddt=round(pw,1) if not np.isnan(pw) else None,
            optimal_furin_P2=s[p1-2] in "KR",
            score=round(3.0+c_motif+c_prime+c_pos+c_dis,1),
            site=f"{s[p1-4:p1]}|{s[p1:p1+4]}"))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("score",ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print("=== Ranked candidate BLI-4 cleavage sites in C. elegans cuticle collagens ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("ranked_candidate_BLI4_sites.csv",index=False)
print("\nRank of the two hypothesis targets:")
for g in ["DPY-17","SQT-3"]:
    r=T[T.collagen==g].iloc[0]
    print("  %-7s rank %d/%d  score %.1f  site %s  pLDDT %.0f  d(GXY) %d"
          %(g, int(T.reset_index().index[T.reset_index().collagen==g][0])+1, len(T), r.score, r.site, r.plddt, r.dist_to_GXY))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))
t=T.sort_values("score")
cols=["#E45756" if c in ("SQT-3","DPY-17") else ("#54A24B" if c=="DPY-5" else "#4C78A8") for c in t.collagen]
